scope: one rank-process aggregate for each of two independently initialized instrumented one-step runs; not per-fifth-solve counters
interpretation: Candidate aggregate retired fewer instructions despite greater process CPU and elapsed time, with more involuntary context switches; this contradicts an explanation based solely on more aggregate retired instructions. Same Tile object bytes do not establish equal later inputs or execution paths. These aggregate counters do not identify a particular scheduler, application, processor, swap or fifth-solve cause. Cycles divided by CPU time is not a measured operating frequency. Historical A8 used a different SDK; no causal explanation of that run is established.
